carol: Quick: drafting internal RN for tonight's staging deploy (db-9001) at 22:00 UTC. Need copycheck + rollback rules. @maria @phil

carol: RN draft:
```
Internal: staging deploy db-9001 22:00 UTC
- What: rollout of optimized attention kernels + quant profile.
- Expected: ~12-18% p50 improvement for long-context and small embedding cost reduction. No API change.
- Rollout: 10% canary for 8m -> 100% if healthy.
- Auto-rollback: revert to model-v1.11-quant if failures >2.5% sustained 5m or latency p95 increases by >30%.
```

maria: Suggest tightening auto-rollback: failures >2% OR p95 increase >25% sustained 5m. Also add contact oncall-joe.

phil: LGTM. I'll post pinned RN once deploy-bot schedules.

deploy-bot: @carol scheduled job db-9001 for 2024-10-12T22:00:00Z status: pending.

oncall-joe: I'll standby 21:50-22:30 UTC. Manual rollback threshold: sustained 5xx >0.8% or p95 >2s. Assigning self to db-9001.

carol: Thanks — pinning RN to #eng-releases (internal only) and handing off to phil to publish. Closing unless rollback.
